decision.rationale_summary: Native OKX EEA Pro-Terminal erfüllt das Owner-Ziel (trading-freie, dichte, persistente Beobachtungsstation) nach Evidenz nicht. HYBRID nutzt OKX nur für authentifizierte Kontextdaten und ergänzende Read-only-Seiten; echte visuelle/inhaltliche Zielerfüllung erfordert später eine lokale Read-only-Workstation mit separater Datenquellen-Freigabe — ohne V6B–V6F-Layout-Experimente fortzusetzen.

owner_goal_vs_evidence_gap.owner_goal_measured: Dauerhaft sichtbare, trading-arme Beobachtungs-UI (kein Orderformular, keine Kaufen/Verkaufen, OB+T&S parallel, integrierte Marktübersicht)

OPTION_A_NATIVE_OKX.safety: HIGH if operator discipline; UI always exposes order paths
OPTION_A_NATIVE_OKX.maintainability: LOW — UI DOM/layout drift, fragile automation
OPTION_A_NATIVE_OKX.peak_trade_trading_authority_separation: STRONG — no Peak Trade coupling required

OPTION_B_HYBRID.description: OKX Safari: WS1 multi-chart + WS2 futures terminal for live microstructure/account tabs; separate Safari tabs/bookmarks for /de/markets/futures and /de/account/users; no further layout automation
OPTION_B_HYBRID.information_density: MEDIUM — split across tabs; main tab remains trading UI
OPTION_B_HYBRID.data_freshness: HIGH on terminal; account rollup near-live
OPTION_B_HYBRID.maintainability: MEDIUM — manual runbook, no DOM hacks

OPTION_C_LOCAL_READ_ONLY_WORKSTATION.description: Architecture-only: dedicated local UI (browser or desktop) composing read-only feeds; no order endpoints; no Peak Trade execution coupling unless explicitly authorized in a future charter
OPTION_C_LOCAL_READ_ONLY_WORKSTATION.safety: UNKNOWN until data-path charter; design intent HIGH
OPTION_C_LOCAL_READ_ONLY_WORKSTATION.cost: MEDIUM — engineering time; no new paid services assumed
OPTION_C_LOCAL_READ_ONLY_WORKSTATION.okx_ui_change_risk: LOW for local shell; MEDIUM for upstream APIs
OPTION_C_LOCAL_READ_ONLY_WORKSTATION.peak_trade_trading_authority_separation: STRONG if execution APIs excluded by design

OPTION_B.read_only_data_flow: PARTIAL — same as A on terminal tab

ui_layers: Layout shell (persistent tiles: chart, depth, trades, positions, funding/OI, market list)
Account mirror (optional, authenticated read-only OKX account API or manual import — UNKNOWN feasibility here)
explicit_non_sources_until_charter: Legacy architecture documents without CURRENT validation
data_source_categories_requiring_owner_g: OKX public market data (REST/WebSocket) — legality, EEA endpoints, rate limits
OKX authenticated read-only account endpoints — scope, keys, IP allowlist
Third-party market data — cost and ToS
Any Peak Trade CURRENT read-only export — must be proven CURRENT_FIRST in separate mission

smallest_sensible_next_step.scope: Inventory and security review of authorized read-only feeds only; no implementation; no Safari layout experiments; freeze OKX workspace IDs as operational bookmarks only
smallest_sensible_next_step.deliverable: Signed list of allowed endpoints/channels + explicit exclusion of trading/write APIs + decision to proceed or not with LOCAL build
